prompt: Create one production 2D combat animation sprite sheet of THE PAIN from ORIGINAL Metal Gear Solid 3 Snake Eater (2004 PS2). Closest 1:1 ORIGINAL costume/anatomy supported by the supplied canonical Shinkawa drawing and Konami original game-model color image. Never remake/Delta. Huge stocky muscular broad-shouldered middle-aged man, head proportionately small. Phase ONE fully covered head: dark charcoal tight BALACLAVA covering head, mouth and nose with only narrow flesh strip at eyes, no bare face and no gas mask. ORIGINAL color image overrides monochrome interpretation: full black/charcoal long sleeved padded/textured field suit, orange ochre/yellow sleeveless flotation-like heavy chest vest with straps and dark gray upper shoulder protection, 2 horizontal ochre cartridge rows across the chest/belly, ochre rectangular pouches at hips/back, black wide belt, dark gray trousers reinforced knees, black combat gloves and plain black tall boots. Keep recognizable original rounded massive torso, broad thick upper arms, tight black head and ochre front breast panel. NO bare arms, armor redesign, helmet, scarf, goggles, modern military plates, weapons, guns, magic, horns, bee aura or floating insects on body. Crisp ink contour and restrained detailed cel shaded polished fighting game artwork, readable dark contour on true transparent alpha, consistent costume and scale, exact head and fully visible boots. Output ONE PNG: exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 entirely isolated full body figures, one per equal cell, no touching. All characters face SCREEN RIGHT (nose, chest and front foot face right), mild side three-quarter so vest remains visible; do not mix directions. Leave large TRANSPARENT OUTER MARGINS and broad transparent gutters, each full figure stays within own cell even hands/feet, never clipped. No labels, text, boxes, checkerboard, background, ground shadows. Row-major poses: 0 idle solid stance hands relaxed fists at sides; 1 idle subtle shoulder breath knees slightly relaxed; 2 walking right left foot planted forward; 3 walking right passing step right foot forward; 4 walking right push-off left heel raised; 5 walking right settling right heel; 6 standing guard forearms crossed firmly in front chest; 7 guard crouched slightly shoulders tighter; 8 LOW CROUCH knees bent deeply toes grounded chest forward; 9 same low crouch one fist to chest; 10 JUMP bent knees lifted arms out for balance but still wholly isolated full body with boots; 11 jump descent knees extending arms down. Exactly 12 complete figures, true alpha zero in every margin.
